environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster running the notification-consumer as a Deployment in namespace 'messaging'. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with no security context restrictions. The SQS queue accepts messages from any authenticated IAM principal in the account. SMTP relay at internal postfix instance accepts all outbound mail without header validation. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. Namespace labels: none relevant to pod security.
